tests.report:
Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and clicking Start (several times), the start was correctly refused: badge stayed 'Gestoppt', Start button still shown, speed 0, log empty. However the message never became visible: a toast element (role=status) with the text 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' exists in the DOM but stayed hidden in all snapshots, a 3-second wait (10 checks) and a screenshot taken right after the click.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Train positions move live in the preview
Expected: At least one train marker is at a clearly different place on the track in the second screenshot
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open, so Stop was clicked ('Gestoppt'). Stop lists were already Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4 and Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2. After Start the badge showed 'In Fahrt' and the log showed 'Start', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:33:28). Screenshots after 5 s and after a further 3 s were identical: the 'Bahn 2' marker stayed on the lower siding near Weiche 2, the 'Bahn 1' marker (present in the accessibility tree) was not separately visible, speed stayed '0 cm/s' and no further log entries appeared. No train marker moved.
Steps completed before failure: 7

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; each train seen moving in its own sense in at least one pair of consecutive screenshots
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open, Stop clicked ('Gestoppt'); stop lists were already correct. After Start ('In Fahrt') five screenshots at ~10/15/20/25/30 s were identical: only the 'Bahn 2' marker visible, standing still on the siding near Weiche 2; no 'Bahn 1' marker visible on the loop. Speed 0 cm/s; the log after 'Start' only shows 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:34:41) and nothing more. No movement, so no direction could be observed.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Before the test the 'Weichen' history had 12 applied entries. App showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct. After Start and 2 x 30 s wait, the 'Weichen' history was unchanged (still the same 12 entries, applied: 12). Locomotive histories were also unchanged (Bahn 1: 20, Bahn 2: 18 applied speed changes, both speed 0): after the restart the trains never moved and no switches were set; the app log only shows 'Start', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet'.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains at least one entry '<train> weicht aus' and, later, an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' for the same train
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct; Start clicked (latest 'Start' at 12:38:45). About 100 s later the only newer entries were 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:38:45); no 'weicht aus', no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', no 'erreicht' entries; speed stayed 0 cm/s. The trains never moved after the restart (same for the earlier Starts at 12:33:28, 12:34:41, 12:36:30; only the very first run at 12:31-12:32 logged an evasion).
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further '… erreicht …' entries for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct; Start at 12:41:30, then 4 x 30 s wait. The only log entries newer than that Start were 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:41:30); no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', 'fährt weiter' or 'erreicht' entries. Both trains stayed waiting (app stuck), as in the earlier Starts at 12:33:28, 12:34:41, 12:36:30, 12:38:45.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct; Start clicked. Log only shows 'Start', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:44:52); speed stayed 0 cm/s, no train moved. All three screenshots (8 s apart) are identical: only the 'Bahn 2' marker is visible on the lower siding near Weiche 2; the 'Bahn 1' marker listed in the accessibility tree is not visible anywhere, apparently hidden under Bahn 2 at the same spot - the markers overlap on the same track section and the trains are deadlocked.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2'
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct; Start at 12:46:34, then 5 x 30 s wait. Final snapshot: badge 'In Fahrt', 'Verbunden', speed 0 cm/s; the only log entries after the last Start are 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:46:34); no 'erreicht Haltestelle' entry at all. The trains never move after Start.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history of this train shows, after normal-speed entries, a new low calibration-speed entry, later followed by its normal speed again
Observed failure: Badge showed 'In Fahrt' on open; Stop clicked; stop lists already correct; Start at 12:50:33, then ~2.3 min of waiting. Log after the last Start only has 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet'; no 'wird kalibriert'/'ist kalibriert'; speed 0 cm/s. Mock console: both trains at speed 0, no speed command reached either locomotive after this Start (last message ~12:33 app time). The app accepts Start but never drives the trains again, so no recalibration during operation happens.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: The log shows, from old to new, 'Start', 'Stop' and 'Start' again, and after the second 'Start' at least one new entry '<train> erreicht <stop>'
Observed failure: Start (12:57:18), 20 s, Stop (12:57:46), 3 s, Start (12:57:54), 60 s. The log shows Start, Stop, Start in order, but after the second Start the only entries are 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (12:57:54); no 'erreicht' or 'fährt weiter' entry in ~60 s; speed 0 cm/s. The last time a train reached a stop was 12:32:40; after a Stop/Start cycle the trains stay stuck waiting.
Steps completed before failure: 12
